materials.finding: Linked ticket VCST-5073 "Add address search by ID" (Task, status Done, resolution Done). It is linked to VCST-4857 as "Blocks (is blocked by)", so VCST-4857 is blocked by it. The work was already done and released in the profile xAPI module. It adds an optional `ids: [String]` argument to the GraphQL queries `currentCustomerAddresses` (the current user's contact addresses) and `currentOrganizationAddresses` (the current user's organization addresses). Both queries filter by the given address ids. The filter works with the existing `keyword`, `countryCodes`, `regionIds` and `cities` filters, with pagination (`first`/`after`) and with `sort`. Behaviour notes in its comments: (1) the filter is applied on top of the mandatory member/user isolation, so foreign addresses are never returned even if their id is supplied; (2) `ids: []` means no filter and returns all addresses; (3) GUID matching is case-insensitive; (4) duplicate ids are deduplicated; (5) invalid, non-existent or null values return an empty result, not a 500; (6) a 500-id list works. The description says to add the search to GetCurrentOrganizationAddresses and GetCurrentUserAddresses. Files named in the comment: MemberAddressSearchCriteria (adds `Ids`), BaseAddressesQuery (argument registration), BaseAddressesQueryHandler (pass-through), MemberAddressService (maps to AddressSearchCriteria.ObjectIds). The linked ticket has no acceptance criteria field.

hotspots.risk: CORPORATE_LIMITED isPaginated depends on the unfiltered book total (addressBookTotalCount > 0). Check that a corporate-limited user with 10+ org addresses, no CanEditOrganization and no local addresses stays on the server-paginated list and keeps the add-address button hidden after a zero-result search, a clear and a page change.

addressBookTotalCount is updated only when not loading and the keyword is empty. Check that it is not stale or 0 on first load or after sign-in/out, since hasAnyAddresses, isPaginated and the add-new button all depend on it.

isSearchPending is true whenever search differs from keyword, with 'undefined' and '' treated differently by the clear button versus keyboard clearing. Check that the loader stops after typing then clearing by ✕ and by keyboard, and after the selector remounts on a breakpoint change.

The selected address is resolved by a separate ids lookup (ids: [selectedAddressId ?? ""]) because it may not be on the current page. Check the header shows the selected address when it is not on page 1 or in the search result, that no second spinner or extra query fires on page or search change, and that a stale lookup is not shown right after selecting a new address.

The just-added address is found in the mutation response by isSameAddress, which ignores null and empty fields. Check that adding an address from the header or checkout for personal and corporate users selects the new address and does not leave address.id undefined or pick the wrong one.

createSharedComposable turns this into one shared instance, so search keyword, page and localStorage state persist across header, mobile header, catalog and checkout consumers and across sign-in/out in the same page session. Check keyword and page state after a breakpoint change, and the selected address after switching user without a reload.

hasAnyAddresses comes from the unfiltered book total, which can lag while a search clears. Check the popover is not unmounted, closing an open dialog and swapping in the add-address button, during a search-then-clear transition or a zero-result search.

showSearch now needs a non-empty filter or more than 6 addresses in total. Check the search box appears only above 6 addresses, stays visible while a zero-result search is active, and that pagination (showFooter, pages > 1) replaces the See more / See less button for paginated users but not for anonymous or local-list users.

The client-side duplicate-address check (accountAddressExists) was removed, so saving the quote's Add address form now always calls the update mutation. Check no duplicate address appears in the account list for shipping or billing, including when the same address exists on another page.

The quote address modal is switched to server pagination (paginationMode server, refs passed, pageSize 6 passed explicitly on L368). Check page navigation, loader and page count in the Select address modal for a personal and a corporate user with more than 6 addresses, and that it opens on page 1.

userHasAddresses is now based on totalCount of the paged query instead of the array length. Check the Select address and Add address choice on the quote page for a user with zero, one and many addresses, and for a corporate user whose organization has none.

After address mutations the lists are refreshed through apolloClient.refetchQueries on active GetCurrentUserAddresses and GetCurrentOrganizationAddresses; the mutations themselves run on graphqlClient, and the composables no longer call refetch(). Check that after add, edit, delete and favorite/unfavorite the account page, header Ship to, checkout and quote lists update without a reload.

claims.text: Replaces the deprecated useOrganizationAddresses and useUserAddresses with useCurrentOrganizationAddresses and useCustomerAddresses, backed by real server-side pagination and search.
The deprecated composables loaded up to 9999 addresses in one shot.
Migrates the two remaining consumers: useShipToLocation.ts (header and mobile Ship to selector) and edit-quote.vue (quote shipping and billing address modal).
Deletes the deprecated composables, their unused GraphQL queries getMyAddresses and getOrganizationAddresses, and their barrel exports.
